scope: Same captured P2/C96/T10 source task; no downstream consumer schedule

pipeline.stage_A: signed48 add/sub, RNE increment, compare, or input/pass
pipeline.stage_B: signed24 saturation or signed48 pass to RF; gate bit to collector
pipeline.latency_rule: Issue at t reads old RF; stage A registers at end t; stage B writes at end t+1; readable at t+2. LOAD and gate follow the same rule.

input: 192 bits/slot, same batch-major/T arrival starting at absolute slot 0 as prior experiment; writes at slot end

compiler.selection: fewest static instruction slots including NOP, then lowest allocated-register peak; never choose from backpressure phase
compiler.RAW: dependency readiness includes two-slot latency; explicit ROM NOP if no node can legally issue
compiler.RF_lifetime: reserve destination at issue through writeback and last actual consumer issue; last-use overwrite reads before writes
compiler.fusion: only single-consumer round -> unshifted signed24 sat becomes norm24; no numerical boundary removed
compiler.gate_cutoffs: retain ordinary ten and lifting last-five exact gate-only cutoff folds in both controls
compiler.commit: all gate writes and interstage state must drain before COMMIT

comparison_boundary: All four arms receive this same hardware. Old one-slot source results are a different resource point, not a same-area comparison. No clock, SRAM macro, RTL or PPA claim.
decision_boundary: 10-15 percent is a service-gain grey zone, not an AEE tolerance. Relative AEE limit remains +0.005. This source-only experiment cannot authorize full-chain PASS or paired recovery by itself.
